dimensions: repetition or promotional reuse can reduce trust
withdrawing a contemplated offering can reduce immediate dilution overhang
positive catalyst interpretation may still require price confirmation
authorization to pursue is weaker than execution
a specific announced economic amount differs from an unquantified proposal
no-news attention can be regime or theme dependent
active-theme fit and simple news presence are separate
news arrival can focus attention without proving materiality

retained_required_unknown_axes: novelty without a complete prior-event corpus
theme fit without a causal theme state

decision.reason: The transcript evidence supports recording these distinctions, but it does not validate an automated interpretation model or a trading threshold.

next_validation.required_panel: chronological held-out trade and skip examples with causally available title, article or filing evidence
required_comparisons: repeated versus genuinely new issuer news
offering initiation versus withdrawal or cancellation

residual_limits: The protocol records explicit title language; it does not establish catalyst quality.
Provider symbol tags do not prove issuer relevance.
Title-only evidence cannot prove company-relative economic materiality.
A causal complete prior-event corpus is still required to judge novelty or confidently rule out repetition.
A causal theme state is still required to judge active-theme fit.
The ARTL, ZEVAI, DSY and VRAX narratives are retrospective and never enter runtime reconstruction.
